{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOBGLqvc8AAAABVyLxhw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlvlNzg_UfMg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlvlN", "number": 25, "title": "Convert PMX bone morph translations and rotations to right-handed coordinates", "body": "## Problem

PMX type 2 **bone morph** elements are already parsed as `{ index, position, rotation }`, but `Parser.leftToRightModel` currently converts PMX morph **type 1 (vertex)** only. Thus `parsePmx(buffer, true)` returns a right-handed PMX model containing still-left-handed bone morph translations and quaternions. `three-mmd-loader` is implementing bone-morph playback and must not consume inconsistent coordinate data.

## Scope

- Extend `leftToRightModel` to convert each **type 2 bone morph** element's translation vector and rotation quaternion, using the same handedness conventions as existing VMD bone motion and VPD transforms.
- Preserve the typed PMX type 2 data shape, element order, bone indices, and original values when parsing with `leftToRight=false` or omitted.
- Leave type 1 vertex morph, group morph references and all unrelated types/sections unchanged.
- Preserve current conversion idempotence: calling `leftToRightModel` again on already right-handed data must not re-flip anything.
- This issue is the **parser prerequisite** to runtime bone-morph playback in [three-mmd-loader](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader). Publish a new npm version later through the maintainer's existing `npm publish` workflow; no npm publishing is required in this Issue.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] A generated PMX fixture containing at least one type 2 bone morph with **nonzero, asymmetric** translation and rotation components verifies both the parsed raw values and converted right-handed values.
- [ ] Translation Z is reflected; quaternion handedness conversion follows the existing `leftToRightQuaternion` convention (with tests that distinguish incorrect sign flips).
- [ ] Bone index, weight-independent morph payload, other PMX sections, and reader alignment are unchanged.
- [ ] Repeated `leftToRightModel` conversion is idempotent and parsing with conversion disabled keeps all original values.
- [ ] Mix of vertex, bone and group morphs still parses and converts appropriately.
- [ ] Existing strict TypeScript, CommonJS, ESM and offline/package regressions pass.
- [ ] `npm run build-uglify`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:offline`, `npm run test:package`, and `npm publish --dry-run` pass without publishing.
- [ ] All acceptance tests are automated and use synthetic data; no third-party models, downloads, visual approval or npm release is required to merge.

## Required post-merge verification

**None** for issue/PR completion. npm release is a separate maintainer action.

## Real-model context

A subsequent loader issue will validate locally using the author's **ビニール傘 — 七篠権平衛** PMX distribution (https://bowlroll.net/file/151308) and optionally **ワイヤーロープ — まりりん** (https://bowlroll.net/file/69264). These are candidate models based on distribution descriptions; their PMX contents and licenses must be checked locally. **Do not acquire, commit or bundle either model as part of this parser issue.**
